what: music-model-test (2026-09-30): the N1 "newer model" option for the music-quality track. ACE-Step 1.5 codec measured against ACE-Step v1 on the same inputs, then one 45 s sketch per cue at -16 LUFS for Bailey to judge by ear in docs/audio/audition.html, section "Music quality options". Nothing here ships.

model.name: ACE-Step 1.5 turbo
model.licence: MIT (model card and GitHub ace-step/ACE-Step-1.5 LICENSE); the model card states generated music may be used commercially

measuredWith: tools/audio/quality-measure.py (as fb-0929) and tools/audio/quality-codec-pair.py (paired, phase-blind: rise at the same input onsets, 1/3-octave magnitude error per band)
cutWith: tools/audio/quality-n1-r1.py (remaster R1 focus, lossless) then tools/audio/quality-sketch.py --encode v0 (50 ms fade in, 1 s fade out, -16 LUFS, true peak <= -1 dBTP measured on the MP3)
